root_cause: ResultPreview accepted an optional source and wrapJsonForAgent printed it, but nine Showcase result callers omitted the source prop. The observed saved-pattern replay therefore copied its row count and rows with no Source URL, although Data's separate copy action did include the source. List Pattern supplied the live tab URL instead of its extraction snapshot.

sibling_census.result_previews: JSON-LD, Microdata, Tables, Snapshot, Framework, AI Extract, Recipes, Patterns, Network, and List Pattern inspected and bound to the source that produced the preview.
sibling_census.doctor_copy: The related Doctor AI copy now uses the probe result's URL and title instead of the currently active tab.
sibling_census.data_copy: Already carried runSource captured before the saved-pattern run; no Data code changed.
sibling_census.list_debug_bundle: Contains fresh/current-page sample HTML as well as the current-page preview; its page URL remains tied to that live sampling action.

result_binding.hook_modes: useExtraction and useAiExtraction return source only for the same page as rows; Recipes stores sourceFromUrl at run time. Their callers pass that source to ResultPreview.
result_binding.patterns: PatternsTab captures URL and title before runSavedPattern, stores them only when the guarded run commits rows, and clears them when the page or run changes.
result_binding.network: NetworkTab passes the selected captured response's URL, sanitized with the credential query keys marked for that selected response. Search and replay URL filter drafts cannot replace the copied source.

credential_handling: ResultPreview uses sanitizePageSourceUrl, built from the existing sanitizeNetworkUrl classifier, on its source URL for both Copy for AI and Send to agent. It masks recognized credential keys in the query and fragment while keeping ordinary query parameters and hash routes that identify the page. Network's selected-response URL is first sanitized with user-marked extra credential keys. The shared clipboard formatter's URL policy was not changed.

source_review_round_1.hash_route_fix: ResultPreview and Doctor now use sanitizePageSourceUrl, which applies the existing credential-key classification to the page query and each hash fragment while retaining route fragments and ordinary query identity.
source_review_round_1.provenance_kind_ruling: The saved Network runner returns rows without the matched response URL. Those rows were extracted during a known page run, so the page URL is valid page provenance; calling it the matched API response would be unproven. ResultPreview now labels the source kind as web page for replay and network response for a selected live captured response. The saved runner is not changed or guessed from its recipe URL filter.
source_review_round_1.connected_guard: The new showcase-ai-copy-source guard renders PatternsTab, the real ResultPreview and real CopyMenu, then reads the clipboard sink after two different saved replays; it also selects a captured Network response, marks a custom credential key, edits the replay URL filter, and checks the copied response provenance. External pattern execution and capture transport are controlled dependencies.
